nodes.label: Ad policy (rewarded + interstitial between levels)
nodes.rationale: No banner to keep game screen clean; interstitial only after level 6, app open >5 min, last fullscreen ad >6 min ago, with timestamp persisted across restarts.

nodes.label: Level simulator robot (tool/simulate.dart)
nodes.rationale: Used to check the difficulty curve after changing lib/core/level.dart; current calibration ~90% wins on levels 1-15, ~40% on 76-90.

nodes.label: Deterministic levels (seeded by level number)
nodes.rationale: Every player gets the same level N, enabling comparison and tuning.

nodes.label: Sawtooth difficulty curve
nodes.rationale: Difficulty rises over four levels to a DIFICIL level, followed by a relief level; overall rises slowly.

nodes.label: Invisible difficulty adjustment
nodes.rationale: Each consecutive loss on the same level makes the next attempt gentler (smaller pieces, line-completing pieces); a very full board also eases the draw.

nodes.label: Always-playable pieces (Solver check)
nodes.rationale: Before dealing three pieces the game verifies an order exists where all fit, so losses always come from earlier moves, never an impossible draw.
